extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: 2-axle municipal winter service truck with front snow plough and rear salt spreader, approx. 7.9 x 3.1 x 2.95 m (L x W x H), plough width 3.0 m
extras.notes: front (plough) faces -Y; the plough blade 'snow-plow_blade' is a separate object with its origin on the vertical pivot of the push frame (rotate around local Z to angle it, approx. -30 to +30 degrees); the spreader with spinner disc is static; 4 wheels (rear dual) are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll); three amber beacons glow softly; opaque tinted windows, no interior; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
